scope.supports: A source-bound complete map of the examined ten C500 block reviews, their250 original target records and exact open/invalid clauses, plus general conditional logical transport principles.
scope.does_not_support: Original campaign completion, independent rerun of every cited finite computation, historical freeze certification, or proof that any open target is false.
scope.narrowest_claim: The examined records do not discharge the original contracts; their scoped labels and partial evidence are retained without promotion.
scope.next_test: Compare every original target/clause row to raw bound sources and challenge omissions or status promotion.
